# NBC News

> > NBC News is a leading news and media organization providing breaking news, investigative journalism, and consumer product recommendations through NBC Select.

NBC Select is NBC News's product review and shopping guide platform, offering expert-tested recommendations, daily deals, and comprehensive buying guides across categories including tech, home, kitchen, and lifestyle. The platform features curated gift guides for all occasions and the NBC Select 100 list of top-tested products.

## Key Topics

- NBC Select
- Product reviews and recommendations
- Shopping deals and sales
- Gift guides for all occasions
- Expert-tested products
- Amazon shopping
- Kitchen and cookware
- Home products and decor
- Tech and electronics
- Daily deals
- Celebrity product picks
- Podiatrist and expert recommendations
- Prime Day shopping
- Seasonal gift giving
- Consumer buying guides

## NBC Select Hub

- [Select | Deals, Tips and Product Reviews | Select | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select): NBC Select main hub for product reviews, deals, and shopping guides
- [NBC Select 100: Top Products We Tested | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/nbc-select-100-50): NBC Select's tested and ranked top 50/100 products across categories
- [Deal of the Day - NBC Select | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/deal-of-the-day): Daily deals across tech, kitchen, apparel from Brooklinen, Sephora, Apple
- [Home Products and Buying Guides - Select | NBC News | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/home): Home products section covering furniture, decor, storage, and cleaning

## Gift Guides

- [Gift Ideas 2026: Best Gifts for Any Occasion - NBC Select | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-ideas): Comprehensive 2026 gift guide hub featuring all occasions and recipients
- [Father's Day 2025 | Best Gift Ideas For Dad | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-guides/fathers-day): Father's Day 2025 gift guide with curated ideas for dads
- [Mother's Day 2025 | Best Gift Ideas For Mom - Select | NBC News | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-guides/mothers-day): Mother's Day 2025 gift guide with curated ideas for moms
- [Valentine's Day Gifts for Her, Him and More - Select | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-guides/valentines-day): Valentine's Day gift guide for partners, pets, and loved ones
- [Graduation | Best Gift Ideas For New Grads - Select | NBC News | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-guides/graduation): Graduation gift guide for elementary, middle, and high school grads
- [Other Occasions and Loved Ones | Gift Ideas - Select | NBC News | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/gift-guides/other-occasions-loved-ones): Gift guide for teens, grandparents, new parents, and other occasions

## Shopping Guides and Top Picks

- [100 Best Things We've Ever Bought on Amazon](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/100-best-amazon-buys-rcna216067): Editor-curated list of 100 best Amazon purchases for Prime Day shopping
- [The 100 Best Gifts We've Ever Given or Received | NBC Select](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/shopping/100-best-gifts-rcna244356): Curated list of 100 foolproof gifts for techies, foodies, and more
- [Talking Shop: Favorite Products From Celebrities, Founders and More | NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/select/lifestyle/talking-shop): Celebrity and founder product recommendations in Talking Shop series
